summary.text: Claire Cory is a Republican member of the North Dakota Senate, representing District 42 (Grand Forks) in the 2025-26 Legislative Assembly. The legislature's biography lists Claire Cory's service as "House 2019-24; Senate since 2025". The member page lists Claire Cory's committee assignments as including Transportation (Vice Chair) and the Judiciary standing committees.

paragraphs.text: The biography lists Claire Cory's occupation as Event Coordinator.
It lists education as BS, BA, UND.
It lists these affiliations and civic roles: CSG BILLD Fellow.
